about:
Icon Solar was founded in 2009 in Milford, Ohio, and has grown into a regional solar installation company serving Ohio, Kentucky, and Indiana. The company operates as a locally owned installer without outside subcontractors, handling every project directly from design through grid connection.

The firm provides turnkey residential and commercial solar installations, including system design, permitting, panel mounting, inverter and battery storage integration, and utility interconnection. It partners with manufacturers such as Franklin WH Home Battery, Enphase Ensemble, and Tesla Powerwall to supply equipment, and emphasizes premium components like black-on-black solar panels and module-level power electronics. Icon Solar describes itself as one of the largest residential installers in the tri-state area, though it does not disclose facility size or headcount.

Customers include homeowners and businesses across more than 50 cities in Ohio, Kentucky, and Indiana, many of whom face rising rates from utilities such as Duke Energy, AES, and AEP. The company also works with municipal solar programs and the 'Find It Duke' referral network. Projects range from rooftop arrays for single-family homes to commercial systems aimed at reducing overhead energy costs.

Icon Solar differentiates itself by refusing to subcontract work, maintaining direct manufacturer relationships, and offering 25-year production warranties on both panels and inverters. It cites an A+ Better Business Bureau rating with zero complaints, a 4.8 Google review score, and a typical installation timeline of about six weeks from permit to grid connection as evidence of its reliability.
